why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
where_to_resume: python tools/triage.py https://playground.rialo.io   # then re-run bulk_apply
steps_from_source: Sign in at playground.rialo.io . New accounts get a 20-point welcome bonus.
Request devnet RIALO from the Account tab. It's a test token with no market value.
Use the apps in the Playground. Warning In Agent Grand Prix you bet points, so you can lose some as well as win.
Link your Discord, GitHub and email, and come back over several sessions.
